title: Novel MOF-integrated MXene-magnetite electrochemical platform for effective detection of chloramphenicol
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00474H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Roxana Paz, Herlys Viltres, Nishesh Gupta, Carolina Leyva, Seshasai Srinivasan, Amin Reza Rajabzadeh
Fe3O4@MXene@Fe-BDC on SPCE provides abundant active sites and conductive pathways, enabling adsorption of chloramphenicol via hydrogen bonding, π–π interactions, and Fe–O bridging, enhancing electron transfer for sensitive detection in water samples.
